meta.title: Prompt Forge
meta.description: Forges plain-language descriptions into WD + Camie image tags and submits them to the local ComfyUI.

title: Prompt Forge
subtitle: Write plainly; forge WD + Camie tags straight into ComfyUI.
placeholder.input: A silver-haired girl on a neon-lit rainy street, soaked white shirt clinging, looking back at the camera, cinematic warm light, shallow depth of field…
ref.label: Reference image (locks the pose)
ref.hint: Pick a photo or sketch — its depth map goes into ControlNet
ref.offHint: This workflow ignores the reference image — pick the one tagged [reference] (feiyue-sam3-ref)
ref.err.too-large: Image is over 24MB — shrink it first
ref.err.no-launch-dir: Set the ComfyUI install directory in settings first
state.empty: Nothing forged yet. Describe the picture above, then press "Forge tags".
result.negativeBuiltin: Negative prompt and quality words come from the ComfyUI workflow
hint.bilingual: One per line: (tag:weight) — Chinese. Weights mirror the positive string (bare tag when 1); copy the whole box into ComfyUI
refine.title: Refine
refine.placeholder: e.g. add indoor light and sweat detail
pipeline.title: Local pipeline
ui.head.title: DSh Tagger · Forge
ui.head.sub: Plain words → WD + Camie tags → refine → render. Negative comes from the workflow; quality tags are added locally at the head.
ui.lang.label: Language
ui.settings.hint: Save writes settings.json and takes effect at once, no restart needed. Skip this in the DSH panel — it uses the host model service.
ui.settings.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste it once; leave empty to keep the saved key
ui.forge.title: Describe it
ui.forge.placeholder: e.g. indoor night, a nude girl lying by the bed looking back at the camera, purple eyes, long black hair, glossy skin, soft warm light
ui.forge.repairTitle: Multi-word tags missing from the dictionary become hyphen/apostrophe forms
ui.forge.poseHintsTitle: Poses/view angles named in the prompt are filled from the local dictionary
ui.forge.candidatesTitle: Feed real dictionary tags to the model before forging
ui.result.positive: Positive prompt (this is what ComfyUI gets)
ui.refine.title: Refine (no need to retype the prompt)
ui.refine.placeholder: e.g. add night scene and backlight / remove the extra hand / raise the subject to 1.2
ui.run.title: Render
ui.run.refLabel: Reference image (any photo or line art, runs DepthAnythingV2 → ControlNet)
ui.run.noPositive: No positive prompt yet: write a few words above and hit Forge — rendering uses the forged result.
ui.ref.hintPick: Pick an image (png/jpg/webp, ≤24MB): DepthAnythingV2 extracts depth and ControlNet locks the pose; the prompt only carries content and style.
ui.ref.hintDisabled: This workflow takes no reference image. To lock a pose with your own image, pick the entry marked [ref] (feiyue-sam3-ref).
ui.pose.truncated: , showing the first {n} — narrow the search or switch set
ui.pose.noneOption: (pose library not found — check ai-pose-gallery-zh under the ComfyUI dir)
ui.pose.notPoseWorkflow: This workflow takes no pose variable: pick a feiyue-sam3-pose style template.
ui.pose.notLoaded: Pose library not loaded yet (check ai-pose-gallery-zh under the ComfyUI dir).
ui.pose.searchPlaceholder: Search name / id P016 / category (sitting, lying, kneeling…)
ui.llm.pillMissing: llm not configured (forge will answer no-llm)
ui.llm.statusMissing: No endpoint yet — forge will answer no-llm
ui.llm.savedMissing: Saved, but URL or key is missing — forge still answers no-llm
ui.comfy.launchHint: Make sure ComfyUI is running, or hit "Launch ComfyUI"
ui.wfImport.noFile: Pick a workflow JSON first (the file ComfyUI exports as Save (API Format))
ui.wfImport.needName: Give the template an id (lowercase letters/digits/hyphen, e.g. my-sdxl-t2i)
ui.wfImport.reloadFailed: Imported, but the list did not refresh: {text} (press F5)
ui.boot.failed: Front end failed to read status: {why} (press F5 and check the console)
err.no-llm: No model endpoint: fill Base URL + API Key in settings (the standalone service also accepts DSH_TAGGER_* env vars)
err.no-api-key: Missing API key: settings → API key
err.no-base-url: Missing endpoint: settings → Base URL (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com)
err.bad-llm: Model endpoint returned an unexpected shape
err.http-400: Model endpoint returned 400: usually a wrong model name or parameter
err.timeout: Timed out: the endpoint is slow or the network dropped — raise the timeout and retry
err.bad-json: Model did not return valid JSON (rare — a retry usually fixes it)
err.empty-prompt: Positive prompt is empty: forge first, or type a few tags
err.too-large: Image is over 24MB — compress it first
err.no-launch-dir: Fill the ComfyUI install dir (launchDir) in settings, otherwise the server cannot write images
err.bad-workflow: Bad workflow template format (UI format must be converted with scripts/release/ui2api.mjs)
err.workflow-not-found: No such workflow template — check the template dir
err.no-workflow: No usable workflow in the template dir
err.no-prompt-node: No prompt node found: CLIPTextEncode in the template is unrecognized
err.no-prompt-id: ComfyUI returned no promptId (submission rejected — check its console)
err.unreachable: Cannot reach ComfyUI: hit "Launch ComfyUI" or check port 8188
err.launch-failed: Launching ComfyUI failed — see the command and error in the server log
err.ui-format: This template is UI format and must be converted to API format
err.bad-schema: Bad schema: vars must be an array
err.no-workflow-dir: Set the workflow template directory (comfy.workflowDir) first
err.bad-name: Template id must be lowercase letters/digits/hyphen/underscore, starting with a letter or digit
err.exists: A template with that id already exists - pick another id or tick overwrite
err.write-failed: Failed to write the template directory (check permissions in the server log)
err.max-tokens: Model output was truncated (the server retried with a doubled cap — raise the limit if it persists)
err.method-not-allowed: This endpoint does not accept that method
err.internal: Server internal error — check the server console
ui.profile.label: Model profile (quality tags / order)
ui.profile.custom: Custom: quality tags and switches come from config
